cards.lore: He's totally here now. The lights are on, but the ninja is home.
cards.power: Dissociate: Skip your turn to play a mini-game in your head. If you win, you still lose the actual game.

cards.lore: Gourmet flavor, microwave ambition, Vice-President of Carbs.
cards.power: Microwave Logic: Upgrade any Trash Item to a Luxury Item for 10 seconds. Then it gets cold.

cards.lore: Money can't buy happiness, but it can buy a 14-karat housebroken.
cards.power: Midas Touch: Turn all your debt into heavier, shinier debt. Your car no longer fit through doors.

cards.lore: You'll shoot your eye out, kid. But you'll look cool doing it.
cards.power: Bullseye: Automatically hit any target, but take 1 damage to your own eye.

cards.lore: The crowd cheers! The confetti falls! The teacher asks for your homework!
cards.power: Grade Inflation: Treat any failure (F) as a critical success (A+) for one round. Then reality sues.

cards.lore: In space, no one can hear you play the wrong chord.
cards.power: Solo: Drown out all other players' dialogue. You are immune to logic while singing.

cards.lore: Oh, I just can't wait to impose my monarchy on you.
cards.power: Musical Number: Force all opponents to dance as backup performers. They cannot attack.

cards.lore: Living vicariously through a beard that could deflect bullets.
cards.power: Proxy Power: Summon a legendary hero to do your chores. They will ignore your core values.

cards.lore: The name on everybody's lips is gonna be... wait, what was my name again?
cards.power: Razzle Dazzle: If you are caught cheating, do a jazz hand. You are now innocent.

cards.lore: I'm not tall, I'm festively plump with MUSCLE.
cards.power: Steroid Dream: Double your strength stat. Reduce your IQ stat to zero.

cards.lore: What am I, your maid? (Wait, don't answer that).
cards.power: Role Reversal: Swap social status with target player. They must clean your cards.

cards.lore: Breaking the sound barrier, or just breaking wind?
cards.power: Montage: Complete a complex task instantly by playing one synth music card.

cards.lore: It was... SOAP DISAPOINTING. A tragedy of hygienic proportions!
cards.power: Guilt Trip: Blind yourself to the truth. Gain +10 Pity from all players.

cards.lore: The Ministry will take care of your muggle problem.
cards.power: Pest Control: Shrink your enemies. Squashing them is now free.

cards.lore: Well, that's not gonna work. Physics is a cruel mistress. Gravity is her bouncer.
cards.power: Oops: Intentionally fail a rescue mission.

cards.lore: You turned off the lights? LIFE SENTENCE!
cards.power: Overreaction: Go directly to Jail for a minor inconvenience. Do not pass Go.

cards.lore: He said “Get Out,” so naturally I assumed I am exiled forever.
cards.power: Melodrama: Take literal instructions too seriously. Leave the game weeping.

cards.lore: Woolgathering? No, just remembering the future pain.
cards.power: Flashback: Freeze in place for 3 turns. Relive a bad memory that hasn't happened yet.

cards.lore: Government mandated donation. The A-Plus Plus Plan.
cards.power: Biological Horror: Produce 1000 tokens. You must pay child support for all of them.

cards.lore: There are only two options: Pride or Death. Usually Death.
cards.power: If rejected, destroy the world.

cards.lore: It's just a check-up. A check-up for your SOUL.
cards.power: White Coat Syndrome: Panic! Attack the nearest healer.

cards.lore: If we fail, the rats inherit the earth. (The rats look pleased.)
cards.power: Pandemic: Imagine the worst. Vaccinate the air. Quarantine the deck.

cards.lore: I can see my house from here. Oh wait, I'm freezing to death.
cards.power: Space Madness: You are on the moon. Ignore all terrestrial rules and bills.

cards.lore: 10 lifetimes of bad karma. Thanks, soldier.
cards.power: Nice Job Breaking It, Hero: Try to help. Make it infinitely worse.

cards.lore: Love: The physics of low gravity required in your hair, even if you are bald.
cards.power: Love Filter: All enemies look like potential mates for 1 turn. Cannot attack.

cards.lore: Unwavering enough to make him smile. Hairy enough to scar us.
cards.power: Contradictory Allegiance: Provoke mixed feelings. Reveal this card. All players must sort their brains.

cards.lore: In your fantasy, but our grandchildren will be beautiful.
cards.power: Instant Wedding: Pick an extra life together in the time it takes to order a latte.

cards.lore: Lust: Think. About. Calculus.
cards.power: Uneasy Thoughts: Reject banal dates to prevent a biological reaction.

cards.lore: May I borrow a cup of sugar? And perhaps your dignity?
cards.power: Double Take: Open the door twice. The reality changes based on your thirst level.

cards.lore: Salt the words of whimsy. Wonders worth a thousand doggies! Run.
cards.power: Format Break: Align all text to the right. The world is now a romance novel.

cards.lore: As much as he might wish… nah. She's a robot.
cards.power: Dismissal: Reject your own fantasy before it gets embarrassing.

cards.lore: Be careful what you wish for. Multiplicity is expensive.
cards.power: Clone Wars: Summon duplicates of your spouse. They immediately argue.

cards.lore: This is just like that episode of Steel Samurai.
cards.power: Lobotomy Request: Ask the doctor to remove part of your brain to imagine this.

cards.lore: Disgruntled beast begin to cover it.
cards.power: Domesticated Beast: Like a legendary monster in dry your laundry.

cards.lore: Alternate methods of reproduction. The blood drained from his face.
cards.power: Hormone Vision: Stun all players with pure absurdity.

cards.lore: She drove the image out of her mind. It honked as it left.
cards.power: Denial: I didn't think that. You thought that. Shut up.

cards.lore: “I thought you said you were gluten free?”
cards.power: Sweet Revenge: Destroy all healing item for deal damage. Smile while doing it.

cards.lore: The customer is always right. The pie is always sticky.
cards.power: Service with a Smile: Imagine attacking the customer. Gain +5 Patience.

cards.lore: In the animal world, this would be solved by biting. Let's try that.
cards.power: Feral Mode: Abandon social norms. Tackle the Alpha.

cards.lore: I'm smiling cheerfully. I'm thinking about what your insides look like.
cards.power: Intrusive Thought: Dead massive damage in your head. Do 0 damage in reality.

cards.lore: Who's a good boy? You are!
cards.power: Doggo Reversal: Treat your owner like a pet. Good boy.

cards.lore: Respect your elders, by punching them in effigy.
cards.power: Catharsis Gain strength by hitting your employer.

cards.lore: Empires of the “dead” part. He won't shut up.
cards.power: Haunted Heckler: Summon a dead enemy to mock you. Gain +1 Cool, -2 Sanity.

cards.lore: He imagines he's throwing an action hero through a window. Every. Single. Time.
cards.power: Heavy Lead: Every object you hit is secretly your enemy. Throw them hard.

cards.lore: DIE. Hawaiian surfing in high definition. Beautiful.
cards.power: Total Annihilation: Destroy the entire board in your mind. Walk away cool.

cards.lore: Low fuel, but all the omining I needed is actually to drift.
cards.power: Physics Fail: Fly a vehicle that cannot fly. Crash immediately.

cards.lore: Your grab has been denied. PEW PEW PEW.
cards.power: Farking Out: If you lose money, attack the bank.

cards.lore: He hit a fly. Stephen, flushed like a god.
cards.power: Digest: Solve minor shame with basic physics.

cards.lore: The ultimate transportation. The ultimate barrier. The ultimate smell.
cards.power: Bubble Boy: You are immune to damage, but you cannot interact with anything.

cards.lore: Get across the street. Avoid the trucks. Hold still.
cards.power: Gravity: Test your job like an arcade game. You have 3 lives. You are fired.

cards.lore: I said Financial PANIC!!!
cards.power: Metaphorosis: Mishear a Wall Street term and summon a monster based on the pun.

cards.lore: Is this Swan Lake, but with bear and traffic collisions.
cards.power: High Culture: Confuse the enemy with surreal art.

cards.lore: Caution is important, but world spiders are cooler.
cards.power: Infrastructure: Spending Spend city funds on giant monsters.

cards.lore: They scuttle. They squeak. They pay taxes.
cards.power: Dehumanize: Turn your enemies into vermin. Feed them cheddar.

cards.lore: Unique duel? No. Create 10 clutter.
cards.power: Chore-Fu: Clean the house with martial arts. +3 Efficiency.

cards.lore: The future of hydration is monstrous.
cards.power: Side Effects: Drink the potion. Mutate into a beast. I think it's Cool.

cards.lore: He was just writing a time novel draft in the fly. Reality is optional.
cards.power: Retcon: Rewrite the last turn. You are now muscular and winning.

cards.lore: It makes me feel better to pretend this all leads somewhere.
cards.power: Coping Mechanism: Invent a descendant to validate your suffering.

cards.lore: She loved it.
cards.power: Unreliable Narrator: Lie about the outcome of a dice roll. If caught, take damage.

cards.lore: That's not what happened.
cards.power: Gaslight: Insist your version of events is true. Then enter with a motorcycle.
